decision_authority.decision: option (a) of COND_HIST_PREMISE_DEFECT.md: explicitly adopt the recorded equivalence, restate the main gate against arms that genuinely differ, and record the restatement as a protocol revision
decision_authority.option_b_status: NEGATED by measurement; see evidence item 3. Option (b) (widen the energy budget B so that conditional sampling becomes discriminative) does not work: the two historical samplers remain bit-identical at Bx3.

amends.scope_of_amendment: the identity of the main-gate contrast and the status of the cond_hist arm ONLY. Arms, matched resources, qualification requirements, data plan, required artifacts, explicit non-claims and protected records are inherited from v1 unchanged unless restated below.
amends.why_a_new_file_instead_of_an_edit: v1 is a registered pre-data artifact; editing its bytes would destroy the registration record. The amendment is therefore additive and pins v1 by SHA-256.

amendment_reason.summary: The v1 main gate names cond_hist as the arm the new method must beat by >= 20 utility/day. In this A-v1 configuration cond_hist is not a discriminative arm: it is bit-identical to the unconditional historical sampler. A gate whose contrast provably cannot differ cannot test the hypothesis it was written to test.
amendment_reason.why_this_is_a_protocol_defect_not_a_resu: The defect is about the IDENTIFIABILITY of the contrast, not about any measured gain. It says nothing about the new method, about MaskCO, about possibility or about equivalence, and it does not reopen the sealed I3 adjudication.
amendment_reason.methodological_basis: In decomposition-based integrated demand-management/routing (i-DMVRP) the accepted diagnostic is that an opportunity-cost approximation error matters only if it (i) changes the decision and (ii) does so in states that are actually encountered. A sampler that never changes the decision is decision-irrelevant by construction, so a contrast against it has no power. See Fleckenstein, Klein, Klein & Steinhardt, 'From approximation error to optimality gap', arXiv:2412.13851, and the canonical anticipatory-vs-myopic comparison of Bent & Van Hentenryck (Operations Research 2004 / IJCAI 2003).
amendment_reason.note: The literature basis motivates WHY the contrast must be rebuilt; it does NOT supply the >= 20 utility/day threshold, which remains a project decision.

evidence.fact: cond_hist and uncond_hist are bit-identical at the registered A-v1 operating point
evidence.citation_note: these are 1-instance wiring smokes and must NOT be quoted as performance results

evidence.fact: the codebase already recorded the equivalence as a measured fact over 40 days
evidence.context_verbatim: 影子计划把未来一天的订单塞满后真实能耗几乎恒超 B，逐场景置 -1e6 会把场景相关的价值信息（plan_rev/fuel/rej_loss）全部淹没，使投票退化为「p_c>0 全接 / p_c=0 全拒」的空转（40 天实测 cond≡uncond≡myopic）

evidence.fact: widening the binding energy budget changes the regime but STILL does not separate the two samplers => option (b) negated
evidence.interpretation: The budget hypothesis about the REGIME is confirmed (served jumps 58 -> 197, utility turns large positive), but the sampler separation does not appear at either budget, so the path 'relax B to give conditioning something to say' produces no usable cond_hist baseline.
evidence.must_not_be_quoted_as: a performance comparison between arms; it is a 1-instance wiring smoke

evidence.fact: the 'empty scenario list' candidate explanation is refuted
evidence.value: scenarios non-empty on 8/8 history days; 441 orders still present at clock 12.0
evidence.consequence: the decisive test previously proposed for this (pickup_scenario_nonempty_check.py) is redundant and MUST NOT be presented as an open question

restated_main_gate.primary_confirmatory_contrast: maskco - strong_rolling: mean >= 20 utility/day AND paired instance-level bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
restated_main_gate.attribution_contrast: maskco - recon_only: mean > 0 AND paired CI lower bound > 0 (same-initial-value reconstruction-only control)
restated_main_gate.secondary_reported_contrast: maskco - discard_control: reported to separate information value from consumed compute
restated_main_gate.cond_hist_status: RETIRED AS A GATE, RETAINED AS A REPORTED ARM. It is recorded in every result table for continuity and as the standing evidence that it is non-discriminative at this operating point. No main-gate claim may rest on a cond_hist contrast.
restated_main_gate.direction: the new method must be BETTER (positive difference)
restated_main_gate.why_this_is_not_a_lowered_bar: At both measured operating points strong_rolling is at least as strong as cond_hist (-361.13 vs -376.41 at B; 4541.51 vs 4480.72 at Bx3). Substituting strong_rolling therefore makes the primary contrast harder, never easier. The threshold 20 is carried over unchanged; the program also already required 'a comparison against a qualified same-contract strong rolling controller'.
restated_main_gate.honest_limitation: The >= 20 utility/day threshold was originally calibrated against a cond_hist contrast. Re-pointing it at a strictly stronger arm is a project decision, not a literature-derived constant, and is recorded as such. It is not claimed to be calibrated for the new contrast.
restated_main_gate.no_cross_operating_point_comparison: The sealed I3 40-day four-arm adjudication (cond_hist mean 600.997 on 40 complete days) is a DIFFERENT pipeline and operating point. It is not comparable to, and must never be differenced with, the wiring-smoke or panel numbers above.
